title: 助動詞與語氣
subtitle: Modals & Mood
summary: 助動詞負責表達說話者的態度：可能、必要、建議、假設。多益考的是語意精準度，不是背公式。

sections.title: 能力與可能：can / could / may / might

rows: 過去能力、較客氣的請求、較低可能性

blocks.value: 助動詞後面一律接原形動詞，且助動詞本身不隨主詞變化（沒有 cans、mays）。

items.en: Employees may request additional leave in writing.
items.zh: 員工可以書面申請額外假期。

items.en: The vendor can delivers by Friday.
items.note: 助動詞後要用原形 deliver

blocks.q: Visitors _____ enter the laboratory without proper authorization.
blocks.explain: 助動詞否定式是 may not + 原形動詞。

sections.title: 義務與建議：must / have to / should / ought to

rows: 說話者認定的強制、規定
I have to leave by five.
We had better back up the data.

blocks.value: must not = 禁止（絕對不可以）；don't have to = 不需要（沒有義務）。這兩個意思完全相反，是多益必考點。

items.en: Employees must not share their passwords.
You don't have to attend if you're on leave.
items.zh: 如果你休假就不必出席。

blocks.q: Since the deadline was extended, we _____ work over the weekend.
blocks.explain: 期限延後代表「不必」加班，用 don't have to。must not 是「禁止」，語意不合。

sections.title: 推測語氣與完成式助動詞

blocks.value: 助動詞 + have + p.p. 用來推測或評論過去的事。

rows: He can't have known about it.
The file might have been deleted.
早該做卻沒做（責備、遺憾）
We should have confirmed the order.

items.en: The shipment should have arrived by now.
items.zh: 貨物照理現在應該已經到了。

items.en: There must have been a system error.

blocks.q: The report is missing several pages; the printer _____ malfunctioned.
blocks.explain: 根據證據做肯定推測，用 must have + p.p.。

rows: 普遍事實：If you heat water, it boils.
If we approve it today, we will ship tomorrow.
第二類（與現在事實相反）
If I were you, I would renegotiate.
第三類（與過去事實相反）
If we had ordered earlier, we would have saved money.

blocks.value: 假設語氣的 be 動詞一律用 were，不分人稱：If I were、If he were。
正式文體常把 if 省略並倒裝。

items.en: Were I in charge, I would restructure the team.
items.zh: 如果我負責，我會重組團隊。

items.en: Had we known about the defect, we would not have shipped the units.
items.zh: 早知道有瑕疵，我們就不會出貨。

items.en: Should you have any questions, please contact us.
items.zh: 如有任何問題，請與我們聯繫。
items.note: = If you should have，商務書信高頻句型

blocks.q: _____ the client requested an extension, we would have granted it.
blocks.explain: 主句是 would have granted（第三類假設），if 子句應為 had requested；省略 if 倒裝後為 Had the client requested。

sections.title: 建議、要求動詞後的原形子句

blocks.value: 表示建議、要求、命令、堅持的動詞，其後 that 子句一律用原形動詞（should 可省略），不隨主詞或時態變化。

items: suggest, recommend, propose, request, require, demand, insist, ask, urge, advise
形容詞句型：It is essential / necessary / important / imperative that…

items.en: The auditor recommended that the policy be revised.
items.zh: 稽核員建議修訂該政策。

items.en: It is essential that every employee attend the briefing.
items.zh: 每位員工都務必出席簡報。

items.en: The client insisted that the deadline be moved.

blocks.value: insist 表「堅持某事實」時不用原形：He insisted that he was innocent. 只有表「堅持要求」才用原形。

blocks.q: The board requested that the CFO _____ a detailed forecast at the next meeting.
blocks.explain: request 之後的 that 子句用原形動詞 present。
